query: 有效订单总量是多少
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是'

query: 有效订单的实际销售额，保留2位小数
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是'

query: APP且2025年1月的有效订单量是多少
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' AND platform_type='APP' AND order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2025-02-01'

query: 各平台有效销售额，依次输出平台、销售额，保留2位小数，按平台升序
reference_sql: SELECT platform_type,ROUND(SUM(payment_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' GROUP BY platform_type ORDER BY platform_type

query: 销售额最高的三个商品，依次输出商品编号、有效销售额，保留2位小数，同额按商品编号升序
reference_sql: SELECT product_id,ROUND(SUM(payment_amount),2) AS sales FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY sales DESC,product_id LIMIT 3

query: 数据中最近7天的有效订单量，包含截止日共7个自然日
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' AND order_date BETWEEN (SELECT DATE_SUB(MAX(order_date),INTERVAL 6 DAY) FROM orders) AND (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders)

query: 所有非取消订单中的退款金额合计，保留2位小数
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(payment_amount),0),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status<>'CANCELLED' AND (is_refund='是' OR order_status='REFUNDED')

query: 非取消订单中的退款率，按百分比保留2位小数
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN is_refund='是' OR order_status='REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status<>'CANCELLED'

query: 有效订单中消费达到两次的用户人数，不输出任何用户名
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' GROUP BY user_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)>=2) AS t

query: 有效订单的去重用户总数
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是'

query: 有效订单客单价，保留2位小数
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_amount)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),0),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是'

query: 2025年每月有效订单量，依次输出YYYY-MM月份、订单量，按月份升序
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date,'%Y-%m'),COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' AND order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date,'%Y-%m')

query: 2025年2月相对1月有效销售额环比增长率，按百分比保留2位小数
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date>='2025-02-01' AND order_date<'2025-03-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2025-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2025-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END),0),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是'

query: 2026年1月相对2025年1月有效销售额同比增长率，按百分比保留2位小数，无基期金额返回NULL
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date>='2026-01-01' AND order_date<'2026-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2025-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END))/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date>='2025-01-01' AND order_date<'2025-02-01' THEN payment_amount ELSE 0 END),0),2) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是'

query: 非取消订单中，付款金额超过100元的退款订单数
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status<>'CANCELLED' AND payment_amount>100 AND (is_refund='是' OR order_status='REFUNDED')

query: 各渠道有效订单量，依次输出渠道编号、订单数，按渠道编号升序
reference_sql: SELECT channel_id,COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status='ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(is_refund,'否')<>'是' GROUP BY channel_id ORDER BY channel_id
